flagged.why: TikTok's AI avatar generation tool, accidentally accessible to personal accounts, let users generate agent-produced videos reciting Hitler quotes/harmful speech
Google's AI Overview, a conversational/generative search assistant, gave a user dangerous potty-training advice (using feces) in direct response to a query
AI meeting assistants (Otter.ai OtterPilot, Zoom AI Companion) autonomously recorded/distributed transcripts after participants left, leaking confidential discussions through the agent's own action
A generative AI image-expansion tool used by a conference organizer altered a speaker's photo inappropriately, direct harmful output from a generative AI tool's use
OpenAI's Whisper transcription tool fabricated racial/violent/medical content when transcribing patient-doctor conversations, corrupting output in that interaction
AI-powered accessibility overlays, used directly by blind users for navigation, mislabel/misinterpret content and interfere with their browsing
